title.zh: 传染病（传染病通报）（豁免）条例 2015
title.en: Infectious Diseases (Notification of Infectious Diseases) (Exemption) Regulations 2015

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Infectious Diseases (Notification of Infectious Diseases) (Exemption) Regulations 2015 and come into operation on 29 May 2015.

2.—(1) Subject to paragraph (2), section 6 of the Act does not apply to any registered medical practitioner practising in, or any employee of, any of the medical clinics set out in the Schedule in relation to the administration of an anonymous test on any person for HIV Infection.
[S 449/2016 wef 28/09/2016]
(2) Nothing in paragraph (1) is to be construed as exempting any registered medical practitioner or employee referred to in that paragraph from the duty under section 6 of the Act to notify the Director if a person on whom an anonymous test is administered is found to be suffering from, or to be a carrier of, any infectious disease other than HIV Infection.
[S 449/2016 wef 28/09/2016]
(3) In this regulation, “anonymous test” means a test where no identifying information is asked of the person seeking the test.
3. The Infectious Diseases (Notification of Infectious Diseases) (Exemption) Order 2006 (G.N. No. S 300/2006) is revoked.
